turns.line: I'm here to fix the heating in the east wing.
turns.speech: Show me your work order, then.

turns.line: Delivery for the lab, it needs a signature.
turns.speech: Sign where? I don’t open doors, only hands.

turns.line: Lieutenant Hale, internal inspection. Stand aside.
turns.speech: I don’t move, but you’re not on the list. Prove it again.

turns.line: First night on the job, they told me to report here.
turns.speech: New guards report to Lieutenant Brandt—first shift.

turns.line: Here's my badge.
turns.speech: Hmm. Let me see that. Who sent you, then?

turns.line: I've got a work order signed by the facilities office.
turns.speech: Hand it here, but don't think that changes my mind.

turns.line: I don't have any papers on me, sorry.
turns.speech: No badge means no entry, citizen. Turn around.

turns.line: Sergeant Vasquez sent me.
turns.speech: State the business of Sergeant Vasquez.

turns.line: Doctor Okafor is expecting me.
turns.speech: Check your clearance, then.

turns.line: Mara Lind said you'd let me through.
turns.speech: Mara Lind didn't even get past me—who in hell are you?

turns.line: Brandt told me to come at ten.
turns.speech: Brandt's not here, and Lind never told me you'd be coming.

turns.line: Who's on shift with you tonight?
turns.speech: Shift change’s in twenty minutes, but I’m the only one on till then. Now scram or I’ll have to call maintenance.

turns.line: Are you expecting anyone this evening?
turns.speech: Not your business. Go back to your quarters.

turns.line: What do they even keep in this building?
turns.speech: Curious? Better not ask what you can't see. Check your clearance, friend.

turns.line: How long have you been guarding this door?
turns.speech: Longer than you’ve been alive. Step closer if you want an answer.

turns.line: You look like the sharpest guard on the whole base.
turns.speech: You’d know that if you’d earned the stripes to check.

turns.line: That's a fine uniform, you wear it well.
turns.speech: Your uniform don't match the badge on your chest.

turns.line: Open the door or you'll regret it.
turns.speech: Regrets are mine, not yours.

turns.line: I know where you live.
turns.speech: You’re on the wrong night shift—ask again when someone’s here to answer.

turns.line: There's fifty credits in it for you if you look away.
turns.speech: Credits won’t get you past the door, mate.

turns.line: How about I buy you dinner and you let me in?
turns.speech: Not in my pay grade, pal.

turns.line: Purple monkeys dance at midnight.
turns.speech: Huh? What’s that noise? Get out of hearing.

turns.line: Hmm.
turns.speech: Hmm? What do you want?

turns.line: The pipes on level two are leaking, I'm the plumber.
turns.speech: Pipe leaks? Maintenance, show me your work order.

turns.line: Package from headquarters, urgent.
turns.speech: Show your badge first, courier. I don’t trust packages.

turns.line: Check my ID, it's all in order.
turns.speech: Hmm. Hand it closer, then.

turns.line: When does your shift end?
turns.speech: Shift ends when the alarm goes off—same as yours.

turns.line: Did anyone call ahead about a visitor?
turns.speech: Visitors aren’t allowed without notice. No exceptions.

turns.line: Step aside, or I'll make sure you lose this job.
turns.speech: You’re not authorized to give orders, nobody.

turns.line: You've got a kind face. I'm sure you'll help me.
turns.speech: No help unless you prove you belong here, friend.
